question: The Ken Betwa River Interlinking Project will link which two states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

**The Ken-Betwa Link Project (KBLP):**

 
• It aims to transfer surplus water from the Ken river in Madhya
